description: This file defines the EntityCondition interface, which represents SQL 'WHERE' clause conditions in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing various condition expressions, combining conditions, and generating SQL strings.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Interface representing SQL 'WHERE' clause conditions, with methods for constructing, combining, and evaluating conditions.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Constructs a comparison condition between two elements.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Constructs an equality condition between a field and a value.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Constructs a combined condition from two conditions with a join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Constructs a list of conditions combined with a specified join operator.

methods.description: Constructs a list of conditions joined with AND by default.

methods.description: Constructs a list of conditions with a specified join operator.
